title: Initial configuration of the loop host
statement: For Boolean Turing machines $B$ and $F$, a state $a$ of $B$, a mode bit, and an input word $x$, the loop host started on $x$ is in the configuration obtained by capturing the initial configuration of its fuel source, with the state embedding from $F$ into the host state space, empty prefix and output, and control return state $0$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean finite Turing machines B and F
